basic_profile.name: Khoa Bui

occupation.title: Agricultural conservation planner

basic_profile.biography: Khoa spends his workdays visiting farms, checking erosion controls, and helping landowners plan cover crops and water-saving improvements. He keeps a close eye on Kansas hail alerts because one bad storm can wreck both fields and freshly painted fenders. On weekends he lifts at a no-frills gym, goes line dancing when friends drag him out, and maintains a surprisingly careful notebook of heirloom melon varieties he wants to grow someday.

basic_profile.name: Azusa Bessho

occupation.title: Public engagement coordinator for a metropolitan rail construction program

basic_profile.biography: Azusa spends her weekdays bouncing between noisy station-construction sites, neighborhood meetings, and hurried coffee chats with contractors who know she can calm down an angry room faster than anyone on the project team. At home, she is the mom sending funny parenting reels to her friends at midnight, experimenting with spicy low-carb dinners, and planning weekend outings with her husband and kids even when the laundry is still in a heap. She has a soft spot for romantic dramas and heartwarming stories about strangers being kind, but she is also unexpectedly obsessed with old municipal maps and keeps framed tunnel-boring machine diagrams in her hallway.

basic_profile.name: Hayes Jorgensen

occupation.title: Accounts payable coordinator at a regional credit union

basic_profile.biography: Hayes spends weekdays chasing invoice approvals at a credit union, then unwinds by arguing about NFL preseason depth charts and Panthers-versus-Eagles takes in group chats. His phone feed is mostly touchdown clips, SEC rivalry trash talk, cat reels, DBZ edits, and the occasional husky chaos video as long as it is funny and not overly sentimental. On weekends he details his aging silver Tacoma, hunts for discounted tools, grills pork chops, and gets up early to fish for largemouth bass before the house is awake. He is blunt, loud, and easily wound up, but he is unexpectedly meticulous about pressing his shirts and keeps a small collection of antique motel postcards in a shoebox.

basic_profile.name: Folarin Ezeani

occupation.title: Customer insights and premium home-theater sales manager for a regional electronics retailer

He is also surprisingly fluent in beauty content, partly because he helps his fiancée save makeup and fashion ideas for their Indian-Nigerian wedding mood board. His apartment has a half-finished plumbing fix, a stack of sneaker-release screenshots, and a tiny balcony herb garden he forgets to water until Sunday night.

basic_profile.name: Urvi Mankad

basic_profile.name: Nadia Bellomo

occupation.title: Embedded QA engineer for coastal monitoring sensors

basic_profile.biography: Nadia spends her workdays writing test scripts for tide-gauge firmware, a job that lets her mix engineering discipline with her soft spot for ocean conservation. At home, she is a blunt but devoted mom to two daughters, a Boerboel puppy in training, and a husband who knows better than to interrupt her during Jets games. She likes Sunday church, Christian motivation clips, green eyeshadow tutorials, Ollie’s bargain runs, and trying to make vegan dinners that still leave room for homemade doughnuts. Her oddly specific hobby is keeping a color-coded spreadsheet of every lighthouse she has visited along the Atlantic coast.

basic_profile.name: Jaslene Olivares

occupation.title: Consumer Insights and Education Manager for a textured-hair and skincare brand

basic_profile.biography: Jaslene spends her workdays turning customer feedback about frizz, dryness, breakage, and glow-focused skincare into product training for salon partners and retail teams. After picking up her toddler from daycare, she usually squeezes in a no-equipment workout, tests a Sephora find, and catches up on celebrity gossip or a messy reality-TV reunion once bedtime is done. She is social and upbeat but picky about her feeds, preferring cat videos, mystery thrillers, 90s nostalgia, and specific R&B performance clips over generic music-promo posts. A surprising weekend habit: she restores tiny antique perfume bottles and labels them with handwritten notes about the scent memories they remind her of.

basic_profile.name: Idris Newsome

occupation.title: Treasury risk analyst at a regional credit union

basic_profile.biography: Idris Newsome is a treasury risk analyst for a regional credit union, where he builds liquidity dashboards but keeps a chaotic desktop full of half-finished spreadsheets and NFL tabs. Evenings are split between co-parenting his eight-year-old daughter, laughing at office-grind and parenting reels, and turning Stouffer's lasagna into dinner before helping with homework. He lifts at a quiet gym, argues cautiously about Browns/49ers predictions, and decompresses by practicing calligraphy strokes and sketching wooden cabin designs he swears he will build off-grid one day. He and his boyfriend are saving for a Utah Crater trip, and his most unexpected prized possession is a tiny tabletop harpsichord kit he is slowly assembling.

basic_profile.name: Hemanth Karkera

degrees: Master's degree in Exercise Science with a focus on biomechanics

basic_profile.biography: He is sociable and polished with clients, but he keeps a skeptical streak, especially toward overly sentimental viral inspiration posts. On weekends he grills steak or chicken wings, checks Bears updates, and maintains a surprisingly meticulous collection of vintage fountain pens.

basic_profile.name: Audra Nesbitt

occupation.title: Freelance bridal makeup artist and beauty content coordinator

basic_profile.biography: Audra spends her mornings answering bridal trial inquiries, testing lip stains under ring lights, and recording casual beauty vlogs from the sunny corner of her apartment. She keeps both a prayer journal and a small tarot deck on her vanity, using them less as answers and more as prompts for reflection, faith, and staying hopeful while co-parenting her eight-year-old son. Her calendar is messy and often rescued by voice notes, but she is steady about catching NBA highlights, watching Zatima, and sending friends dating-app comedy clips. Surprisingly, she also collects antique weather radios and keeps one working in her kitchen after volunteering once at a tornado relief supply drive.

basic_profile.name: Sandro Magsino

occupation.title: Legislative aide specializing in transportation safety and rural infrastructure policy

basic_profile.biography: Sandro spends weekdays drafting blunt, meticulously sourced memos on road safety, trucking corridors, and rural infrastructure, then unwinds with Muay Thai drills or a few minutes of mindfulness before dinner with his wife and kids. He is loudest on fall Saturdays when the Tennessee Volunteers are playing, but he is just as happy trading NFL highlight clips, classic country songs, and stand-up comedy bits in the family group chat. On weekends, he might be fishing before sunrise, sketching a backyard pathway project, or volunteering through his church even if he is known for being direct rather than soft-spoken. A surprising point of pride is his small collection of restored vintage fountain pens, which he uses for handwritten notes after public hearings.

basic_profile.name: Graham Jessup

occupation.title: Firmware validation engineer for industrial sensor systems

basic_profile.biography: Graham starts most workdays with black coffee, a checklist of firmware test cases, and Bob Seger playing low enough not to distract him. After hours, he disappears into the garage to build tidy storage benches and cabin-style shelves, usually with his rescue dog asleep near the sawdust and cat videos queued on his phone during breaks. He and his wife like quiet weekend getaways in mountain rentals, but he has no patience for vanlife or cramped tiny-house tours. A surprisingly treasured possession is a restored vintage bowling-pin lamp he found at an estate sale and rewired himself.

basic_profile.name: Fiona Varghese

occupation.title: Speech lab coordinator at a community college

basic_profile.biography: Fiona, a transgender woman, runs a busy campus speech lab where she helps students practice presentations, interviews, and podcast-style assignments, usually with a coffee in hand because early mornings are not her strength. After work she is most alive in social settings, whether she is catching a local stand-up show, debating WWE Raw moments with friends, or swapping fantasy football takes in a group chat. Her evenings often include easy skillet dinners, dance videos, Newfoundland dog clips, and a new Netflix release playing while she half-plans outfits for the week. A surprising point of pride: she keeps a tiny balcony garden of curry leaves and heirloom tomatoes, though she forgets to water it more often than she admits.

basic_profile.name: Maren Quillen

occupation.title: habitat restoration equipment technician for a county conservation district

basic_profile.biography: Maren spends most weekdays hauling brush, maintaining seed drills, and helping restore prairie edges and creek banks for the county conservation district. After work she is usually in the garage with her boyfriend, half-fixing a Fox Body notchback Mustang or cleaning the air filter on her motorcycle while a gaming livestream plays in the background. She loves American Bully dogs, weekend fishing, brisket experiments, and loud car-mechanic comedy clips, but she scrolls right past football highlights and cat-petfluencer posts. A surprising point of pride is her collection of vintage holiday blow molds, which she starts setting up before Thanksgiving whether the neighbors are ready or not.

basic_profile.name: Kieran Ackerly

degrees: Juris Doctor in Animal Law and Nonprofit Compliance

occupation.title: Self-employed animal welfare and pet-trust attorney

basic_profile.biography: Kieran runs a cluttered solo law practice out of a converted sunroom, helping rescue groups with adoption contracts, nonprofit paperwork, and the occasional fiercely worded breeder dispute. They foster bottle-fed kittens between client calls, keep one elderly rescue mutt as their permanent office manager, and unwind with funny dog videos, America's Got Talent clips, and the exact same Robert Redford movie whenever the week has gone sideways. Their kitchen is usually dusted with flour from brioche experiments or last-minute no-bake desserts, though the rest of the house is held together by half-finished organization hacks. They obsessively check storm alerts for Marseille because a former foster adopter lives in North Marseille, and they collect antique fountain pens despite mostly writing everything in panicked phone notes.

basic_profile.name: Nozomi Utsunomiya

degrees: Master's degree in Supply Chain Management

occupation.title: Intermodal freight planning manager for a regional rail-and-port logistics operator

basic_profile.biography: Nozomi spends her workdays juggling rail schedules, container dwell-time dashboards, and tense calls with trucking partners when weather or staffing throws the network off. After work she decompresses with leg day, boxing highlights, MMA clips, and WWE SmackDown segments, while keeping a wary eye on Arsenal and Real Madrid match updates. On weekends she helps a friend refine branding for a tiny food stall and, surprisingly, keeps a meticulous notebook of vintage manhole-cover designs she photographs around the city.

basic_profile.name: Noboru Masuyama

degrees: Master's degree in Public Policy and Intercultural Governance

occupation.title: Municipal international cultural programs officer in a city civic engagement bureau

basic_profile.biography: Noboru is a blunt, energetic civic officer in Osaka whose workdays are packed with grant reviews, neighborhood association meetings, and immigrant community event planning. At home, he follows Ibadan cultural news and Nigerian comedy like Aiyetoro Town with his Nigerian wife, while saving Yoruba wedding photography ideas, Ankara outfit references, and simple French phrases for family calls. He is disciplined about low-calorie lunches and evening prayers, often sharing Muslim inspiration about trusting God’s plan but ignoring pet memes, travel-flex posts, and side-hustle farming content. A surprising weekend habit is cataloging decorative manhole covers across Kansai with a precision that his friends find both impressive and slightly exhausting.

basic_profile.name: An Tạ
basic_profile.biography: Evenings revolve around her husband, their kids' chaotic bedtime routine, and trying to train their stubborn rescue dog not to bark at delivery trucks. On weekends, she co-hosts karaoke trivia at a neighborhood bowling alley and insists the best family memories happen when nobody overplans them.

basic_profile.name: Larisa Ivashchenko

occupation.title: Retail merchandising planner for a regional home decor and furniture chain

basic_profile.biography: Larisa spends her workdays analyzing which affordable sofas, shelving units, and kitchen organizers should get floor space, then quietly fixes messy displays before anyone asks. After closing, she heads to the gym for steady weightlifting sessions and decompresses with Fluffy clips, relationship skits, and the occasional Becky Lynch highlight. She follows boxing news closely enough to have opinions on Benn vs. Eubank Jr., but she tunes out most loud team-hype football posts. Her surprisingly delicate hobby is repairing old mechanical alarm clocks she finds at estate sales.

basic_profile.name: Tadeo Xicay

occupation.title: Housing intake coordinator at a family-services nonprofit

basic_profile.biography: Most weekdays, Tadeo is the calm voice on the intake line at a family-services nonprofit, helping parents find rental assistance, food resources, and practical fixes like getting kids' uniforms clean before game day. After work he decompresses with Terence Crawford fight clips, old Ultimate Warrior entrances, and clean stand-up reels about dating app disasters and office misery. He is shy in big rooms but unfailingly kind one-on-one, and his boyfriend teases him for alternating between Frosted Flakes and high-fiber cereal like it is a moral dilemma. On weekends he slowly works on a handmade wooden bench for his apartment balcony, usually with 1990s hip-hop playing and a tab open about octopus facts.

basic_profile.name: Davia Givens

occupation.title: Licensed HVAC/R technician specializing in high-efficiency heat pumps and green home retrofits

basic_profile.biography: Davia spends her workdays crawling through attics and basements to tune up heat pumps, then comes home full of ideas about making older houses greener without making them look sterile. She keeps Michigan Wolverines football alerts on her phone and will argue about a Lakers highlight clip while testing a new vegan grilling recipe on her tiny patio. Her downtime swings from live stand-up shows and relationship comedy reels to black-and-white movies, haunted-story podcasts, and the occasional DC or Marvel trailer binge. Surprisingly, she is teaching herself calligraphy with fountain pens, even though most of her notes end up scattered across receipts in her work van.

basic_profile.name: Kara Tillinghast

occupation.title: Accounts payable coordinator at a regional credit union

basic_profile.biography: Kara keeps the credit union’s vendor payments running on time, with color-coded checklists, calendar alerts, and a running worry that she somehow missed one invoice. After work, she is usually swapping toddler-chaos stories with friends, playing 90s R&B in the kitchen, or catching up on NASCAR history and Alabama football clips. She loves a loud comedy club night, all-inclusive beach trips, and making homemade elderberry syrup when everyone in the house starts sniffling. Surprisingly, she collects and repairs old mechanical adding machines, which she says are more relaxing than any meditation app.

basic_profile.name: Duy Đinh

degrees: High school diploma, automotive technology track

occupation.title: Self-employed mobile auto-detailing and basic car-care service owner

basic_profile.biography: Duy runs a mobile car-care van, booking neighborhood oil checks, cabin air filter swaps, and quick detailing jobs between school drop-offs and pickup. He is the loud, friendly dad at the park with a rescued pit bull mix, usually showing other parents funny goat clips or a homemade lemon soda recipe he wants to try. After work he lifts in his garage to old Tupac and Snoop tracks, then winds down with Korean dramas, Friends memes, or short mystery microdramas on his phone. A surprising habit: he keeps a tiny notebook of jazz riffs he hears, especially Cannonball Adderley solos, even though he does not play an instrument.

basic_profile.name: Minh-Anh Giang

occupation.title: Catering sales manager at a waterfront hotel

basic_profile.biography: Minh-Anh spends her workdays walking couples through banquet menus, calming nervous brides, and making sure the dessert table photographs well before anyone takes a bite. At home, she is a new mom who saves play-based toddler activity ideas, watches Mexican telenovelas after bedtime, and starts most mornings with a short devotional centered on Jesus. She loves polished outfit inspiration, volume-boosting hair tutorials, and cake decorating videos, even though she insists she is better at selling cakes than piping them. Her oddly specific talent is remembering the floor plans of every hotel ballroom she has ever worked in.

basic_profile.name: Zadie Tillinghast

occupation.title: Quality systems coordinator at an industrial coatings and concrete flooring manufacturer

basic_profile.biography: Zadie spends their weekdays on a plant floor tracking batch records, safety checklists, and production issues, then uses Google Workspace shortcuts to keep the whole coatings team from drowning in spreadsheets. After work, they unwind with boxing footwork drills in the garage, Ravens highlights, and the occasional Padres clip if Fernando Tatis Jr. is involved. They are saving for a small home renovation, so their feed is a mix of polished concrete ideas, light-switch repair tutorials, pest-control tips, and T-Mobile deal hunting. A devoted rescue-dog adopter, Zadie also keeps a tiny notebook of unusual cloud shapes they spot during lunch breaks.

basic_profile.name: Yvette Usher
basic_profile.biography: Off the clock, she powerlifts in a quiet garage gym, meal-preps high-protein plant-based bowls, and watches Lakers games or NFL touchdown clips with her rescue dog asleep under the coffee table. She is bisexual and values steadiness in relationships, preferring low-key anniversary trips in the mountains over crowded parties. Her friends know not to interrupt her during WrestleMania or a new Jujutsu Kaisen chapter, but they do ask her to repair their old cassette decks because she secretly restores vintage audio equipment.

basic_profile.name: Isela Lemus

degrees: Master's degree in Real Estate Development

occupation.title: Multifamily property asset manager specializing in tenant retention and renters insurance compliance

basic_profile.biography: Isela spends her workdays reviewing lease performance, maintenance trends, and renters insurance gaps across a portfolio of mid-rise apartment buildings, preferring spreadsheets and blunt emails over networking lunches. At home, she is a new mom who unwinds with quick vinegar cleaning hacks, DIY fall door wreaths, and crispy fried shrimp with yellow rice while short comedy clips play in the background. She follows Jamaican sprinting obsessively, especially 200m record chatter, and has a private habit of timing stroller walks like interval workouts. Though she is guarded with most people, she keeps a tiny shelf of Christian hip-hop CDs in her kitchen and owns an antique harmonica she still cannot play.

basic_profile.name: Sage Kittrell

occupation.title: fraud operations analyst at a regional credit union

basic_profile.biography: Sage Kittrell works in fraud operations for a regional credit union, where they spend the day scanning odd transaction patterns and then somehow leave with three half-finished to-do lists. Their train commute is usually soundtracked by Latto, street-dance battles, and saved outfit ideas that mix casual-chic layers with whatever side-braid style they are trying that week. After work, Sage is the friend organizing a low-drama group dinner at a hidden-gem Atlanta spot, trading newborn-care tips with their cousin, or laughing at pet videos and messy relationship skits on Reels. Surprisingly, they also take weekend glassblowing classes and have a growing collection of tiny imperfect bowls they refuse to throw away.

basic_profile.name: Oviya Ponnusamy

occupation.title: District sales manager for a motorcycle and outdoor recreation retail chain

basic_profile.biography: Oviya spends most mornings checking sales dashboards, coaching store teams, and swapping friendly trash talk with customers about Chiefs touchdowns, Titans highlights, and the Indiana Fever. Off the clock, she rides with a small women’s biker group, listens to Lainey Wilson on back roads, and prefers admiring classic cars at shows rather than getting pulled into repair talk. She co-parents her young son with her ex-wife and saves handwriting worksheets, cat food coupons, and personalized ornament ideas in the same obsessively labeled notes app. On weekends, she is usually bass fishing, watching fight-night clips, or making surprisingly good cardamom cold brew for friends after church.

basic_profile.name: Yubo Ou

degrees: Some college, no degree in construction management technology

occupation.title: CNC layout technician for a bridge and highway steel fabrication contractor

basic_profile.biography: Yubo spends most workdays translating shop drawings into CNC cut files for bridge components, then checking Oklahoma storm updates before the drive home. He is quiet in groups but curious on his own time, rotating between Christian encouragement videos, old-school Run-DMC tracks, boxing knockouts, and app-based piano lessons after his kid goes to bed. He lifts consistently, keeps protein bars in his truck, and likes sketching modern living-room ideas that his wife teases him for overthinking. A surprising point of pride is the tiny balcony herb garden he started from rescued grocery-store basil.

basic_profile.name: Daphne Ouyang

degrees: High school diploma, with business math and bookkeeping electives

occupation.title: accounts payable clerk for a regional auto-parts distributor

basic_profile.biography: Daphne spends her weekdays matching invoices and chasing missing receipts, usually with Love Island USA recaps or office-humor clips playing during lunch. At home, she rotates press-on nails, tries new edge-styling videos, and adds pumpkins and leaf garlands to her apartment as soon as the weather cools. She is relaxed about clutter and deadlines but warm with friends, especially when swapping Cardi B memes, cute kitten videos, or encouragement posts about faith and self-worth. A surprising point of pride is her carefully labeled collection of miniature hot sauce bottles from gas stations and roadside diners.

basic_profile.name: Brielle Katoa

occupation.title: State legislative policy aide focused on consumer protection and insurance regulation

basic_profile.biography: Brielle spends her weekdays drafting bill summaries, tracking constituent complaints about insurance costs, and keeping a color-coded calendar that leaves very little to chance. After work, she meal-preps freezer soups, squeezes in dumbbell workouts, and searches for protective braid styles while managing the beautiful chaos of raising twins. Her phone feed is a mix of Christian encouragement, mom-life comedy reels, hip-hop clips, and the occasional Black Friday iPhone deal she swears she is only “researching.” Surprisingly, she also keeps a small notebook of lighthouse sketches from weekend drives along the coast.

basic_profile.name: Ehsan Zaman

occupation.title: Watershed restoration coordinator for a county conservation district

basic_profile.biography: Ehsan spends most mornings checking farm creeks, logging turbidity readings, and helping landowners plan buffer plantings before heading back to a quiet desk full of maps and spreadsheets. After work, he changes into all-black riding gear, tinkers with his motorcycle in the garage, and catches up on boxing or AEW highlights with his older boyfriend. He is steady and private, but he’ll show up for a beach cleanup, a trout-fishing morning, or a DIY wall repair project if someone he trusts asks. A surprising habit he keeps from childhood is labeling every houseplant with a tiny handwritten tag, even the ones he knows he will probably forget to water.

basic_profile.name: Ruilan Bai

occupation.title: Self-employed vintage-car and small-engine repair creator

basic_profile.biography: Ruilan runs a scrappy garage-based business restoring old Ford parts, filming ATV repair clips, and taking the occasional gig fixing Polaris engines for neighbors who find her through social media. Her days bounce between coffee, a half-finished Model A project, loud Cleetus McFarland videos, and her cattle dog nosing around the shop while she forgets where she put the socket set. She is outgoing and funny with customers, but her bookkeeping is usually a week behind and held together by voice notes and sticky labels. On weekends she likes fishing with friends, trying high-protein meal prep ideas, and playing erhu at a local bluegrass jam night.

basic_profile.name: Dohan Baek

occupation.title: Municipal court records and compliance coordinator

basic_profile.biography: Dohan Baek spends his weekdays processing filings, checking docket updates, and answering tense phone calls from people trying to understand municipal court deadlines. After work, he usually unwinds with Eagles highlights, boxing knockout clips, or arguments about whether Jordan still clears LeBron and Kobe. On weekends he grills ribs in the driveway while his toddler runs circles around the patio, and he keeps a half-finished refinishing project in the garage that he insists is almost done. He is steady but easily stressed, prays through big decisions, and has a surprising habit of memorizing old TV game show catchphrases.

basic_profile.name: Verity Madsen

occupation.title: Treasury operations analyst at a regional credit union

basic_profile.biography: Verity Madsen starts most workdays checking liquidity reports, SR 509 traffic updates, and whatever NFL meme thread her office chat has already found. After work, she is usually at the gym, practicing a steadier golf swing at the range, or hosting family for a low-key Mets or Tennessee Volunteers watch night. She likes polished routines—skincare, budget travel alerts, and a reliable spreadsheet—but has a surprising soft spot for collecting vintage motel keychains from road trips. Friendly and upbeat, she follows celebrity news enough to defend Taylor Swift's privacy while still laughing at stand-up clips on her lunch break.

basic_profile.name: Zosia Haverkamp

degrees: Bachelor's degree in urban and regional planning

occupation.title: County land-use and shoreland zoning coordinator

basic_profile.biography: Zosia spends her weekdays in a county office reviewing farm-access permits, lake setback maps, and zoning complaints, then drives home past cornfields with a Vikings podcast or Twins highlights on. She is the kind of person who will organize a neighborhood landscaping day down to the minute, but she is also blunt enough to tell someone their DIY patio plan is going to fail inspection. Evenings are usually a mix of walking her dog, checking the Wild score, watching WWE clips, or binging a Netflix mystery while sketching tile ideas for her bathroom remodel. A surprising point of pride is that she keeps a small collection of antique fountain pens and uses them to handwrite sharply worded thank-you notes.

basic_profile.name: Paapa Fofie

occupation.title: Community outreach coordinator at a housing-stability nonprofit

basic_profile.biography: Paapa Fofie is a Ghanaian immigrant in Northern California who spends his workdays visiting apartment complexes, food banks, and church basements to connect families with rental assistance and utility-shutoff resources. He is easygoing and talkative, often turning tense intake appointments into lighter moments with a Spanish-language comedy clip or a story from his old restaurant-server days. After work, he might be under his aging Volkswagen watching brake-repair tutorials, arguing with friends about Naruto characters, or dancing badly to cumbia reels while dinner burns a little. Surprisingly, he keeps a meticulous balcony collection of carnivorous plants, even though the rest of his apartment is usually a cheerful mess.

basic_profile.name: Filip Wierzbicki

occupation.title: assistant project coordinator for highway drainage and retaining-wall construction

basic_profile.biography: Filip spends his weekdays bouncing between job trailers, permit spreadsheets, and muddy roadside sites, usually with a Rangers cap tossed on the dashboard of his pickup. After work he unwinds with rescue-cat and dog videos, try-not-to-laugh reels, and the occasional creepy trail-cam clip he forwards to friends with zero context. He has a small shelf of books on medieval castles and early cannons, though his apartment is otherwise cluttered with bass guitar cables and unopened mail. Surprisingly, he makes very neat paper models of bridge piers when he needs to explain a site problem to crews.

basic_profile.name: Georges Rahal

occupation.title: Internal controls analyst at a regional bank

basic_profile.biography: Georges is a blunt but cheerful internal controls analyst who starts most mornings checking audit exceptions, Gmail security alerts, and the Real Madrid score before work. After church on Sundays, he and his wife usually cook together, watch Nollywood dramas, and trade sarcastic reactions to couple-prank videos and relationship skits. He is proud of hyping her plus-size fashion posts online, though he will quickly mute generic fitness transformation clips and track-and-field recaps. His oddly calming weekend habit is repairing small car problems in the driveway, including a stubborn horn, while his orange kitten tries to sit inside the toolbox.

basic_profile.name: Kaleo Palakiko

degrees: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management

occupation.title: Fleet operations analyst for a regional flatbed towing and roadside assistance company

basic_profile.biography: Kaleo spends his workdays tracking tow trucks, rerouting drivers around weather snarls, and quietly troubleshooting diesel maintenance issues before they become expensive breakdowns. After hours, he decompresses with paranormal horror, boxing cards, Bad Friends clips, and too many voiceover cat videos, usually with his rescue dog asleep against his leg. He keeps a project notebook for a future classic Ford F-100 restoration and disappears on occasional weekends for fishing, Route 66 diners, or off-road truck meets. Despite his reserved nature, he is known among friends for bringing homemade guava shortbread to watch parties and for sending oddly beautiful photos of storm clouds over truck yards.

basic_profile.name: Anwen Qiu

degrees: Master's degree in Urban Planning and Real Estate Development

occupation.title: PropTech adoption manager for a mixed-use commercial real estate firm

basic_profile.biography: Anwen spends her workdays helping leasing teams test digital tenant-experience tools, then walks construction sites in flats she keeps under her desk. After work she is usually at a barre class or saving upbeat dance-crew clips to try with two friends on weekends. Her phone feed is full of sentimental relationship edits, Mexican sitcom comedy snippets, and soccer memes about star forwards, but she scrolls past combat-sports hype almost instantly. Unexpectedly, she collects vintage transit tokens from cities she has visited and keeps them in a tiny velvet jewelry case.

basic_profile.name: Sirinya Nakarat

occupation.title: Cost accountant for a building-materials distributor

basic_profile.biography: Sirinya starts her workdays reconciling vendor invoices and margin reports for a building-materials distributor, then spends lunch comparing tool reviews and jotting down ideas for a mortise-and-tenon side table she swears she’ll finish. After work she is usually the loudest friend in the group chat, sending Jamaican comedy clips, couple skits, and the occasional dance-battle reel, though she can be blunt when people ignore boundaries. She keeps a close eye on Montego Bay weather alerts because her aunt lives there, and she checks Bangkok headlines before bed out of habit. On weekends, she bakes pandan waffles in a vintage cast-iron waffle maker and insists family dinner is non-negotiable.

basic_profile.name: Jazmín Pantoja

degrees: Master's degree in Real Estate Development

occupation.title: Commercial property asset manager focused on mixed-use and light-industrial redevelopment

basic_profile.biography: Jazmín spends her weekdays walking job sites, reviewing tenant improvement budgets, and talking contractors through practical fixes for older commercial buildings. After work, she is just as likely to be watching boxing breakdowns, NFL analysis, or classic country videos as she is sanding a cabinet door or helping her husband troubleshoot a stubborn truck issue. She has a soft spot for rescue dogs, backyard chickens, and goofy couple memes, but she is surprisingly serious about collecting antique hotel key tags from places she visits. On weekends, she likes fishing before sunrise, browsing tool deals, and taking nature photos on quiet back roads.

basic_profile.name: Hodan Roble

occupation.title: Undergraduate presentation-skills coach and learning center coordinator

basic_profile.biography: Hodan Roble is a Somali immigrant who spends their workdays helping first-year students rehearse presentations, calm their nerves, and turn messy ideas into confident classroom delivery. Their group chats light up during India vs Pakistan cricket matches, and they have a soft spot for Punjabi couple-comedy clips and wedding dance videos, though they skip preachy inspirational posts and most dog content. On quiet weekends, Hodan crochets scarf edges while listening to Punjabi songs and cataloging a small collection of vintage subway tokens from cities they have never visited.

basic_profile.name: Waleska Huamán

occupation.title: Post-production supervisor for a streaming television network

basic_profile.biography: Waleska plans edit calendars and quality checks for TV award-season clips, preferring quiet control rooms and precise delivery specs over red-carpet chatter. Her weekend projects swing from patching a stucco wall to testing a deviled egg recipe for Easter, always logged in a color-coded notebook. She has a soft spot for police K9 videos and keeps a framed photo of her late grandfather’s green Kawasaki in her hallway.

basic_profile.name: Mateo Zubieta

basic_profile.biography: Mateo spends his weekdays building cost models for excavators, haul trucks, and specialty trailers, then unwinds in his garage changing oil or chasing down stubborn suspension parts on an old barn-find coupe. On weekends he takes his Golden Retriever and camera to lakeside trails for eagle-in-flight photos, follows PGA Tour leaderboards, and fishes for largemouth bass before heading home to watch a John Wayne Western with his wife. His one unexpectedly delicate hobby is restoring vintage fountain pens, which he keeps in a labeled case beside his socket sets.

basic_profile.name: Makoa Hanohano

He and his girlfriend foster rescue dogs, and their living room is often split between UFC fights, WWE events, and goofy Will Ferrell comedies. A surprising soft spot: he keeps a meticulous notebook of rare tropical plants he wants to grow on a tiny balcony garden.

basic_profile.name: Iseul Seo

occupation.title: Landscape lighting and irrigation installer

basic_profile.biography: Iseul Seo is a transgender woman who spends most workdays trenching clean lines for irrigation, wiring low-voltage landscape lights, and telling homeowners exactly why their drainage plan will fail if they cheap out. She loves Met Gala and Fashion Week coverage for the construction of the clothes, not just the celebrity gossip, and she has a small notebook where she sketches tattoo ideas next to chess puzzles. Her one oddly quiet hobby is restoring antique hand planes, which she says is the only social media-free part of her week.

basic_profile.name: Quetzali Arriaga

occupation.title: Assistant Food and Beverage Manager at a boutique hotel

basic_profile.biography: Quetzali runs tight dinner-service schedules at a boutique hotel, tracking vendor deliveries, lounge reservations, and last-minute kitchen problems with color-coded checklists. After work she decompresses with hip-hop release news, funny couple skits, puppy videos, and the occasional Mike Tyson legacy clip. Her closet leans practical but stylish, with Target winter hoodies she dresses up for concerts or late-night tacos with her boyfriend.

basic_profile.name: Idris Vaziri

occupation.title: Senior policy analyst for a New York State legislative committee on consumer protection, sports regulation, and live-event ticketing

basic_profile.biography: Idris Vaziri spends his workdays parsing ticketing complaints, combat-sports licensing rules, and consumer pricing data for live events around New York. After hours, he keeps a tight rotation of interests: Hot 97 clips, Terence Crawford and Canelo analysis, old Pacquiao-Márquez fights, and the occasional ONE Championship card. He likes New York Fashion Week coverage more for the streetwear and crowd logistics than the runway spectacle, and every October he quietly overdoes the fall decorations in his apartment. A surprising point of pride is his small collection of antique subway maps, which he frames himself on slow Sunday afternoons.

basic_profile.name: Owen Eberly

degrees: Bachelor's degree in Real Estate Finance

occupation.title: Acquisitions manager for a small real-estate redevelopment firm

basic_profile.biography: Owen spends weekdays walking neglected duplexes and small retail properties, bluntly pricing out repairs before deciding whether they are worth a bid. After work he is usually in the garage troubleshooting an old transmission, installing a hitch on his truck, or watching comedy sketches while his rescue mutt naps nearby. Weekends are split between fishing trips, dirt bike trails, and the occasional government surplus auction for project vehicles. He is unexpectedly meticulous about making textured abstract wall art for the rentals he renovates himself.

basic_profile.name: Yiming Tan

occupation.title: Banquet operations coordinator at a boutique hotel

basic_profile.biography: Yiming Tan spends most days coordinating event setups, smoothing over last-minute menu changes, and chatting easily with hotel guests and catering staff. Off shift, he likes practical sewing tutorials, especially thrift-flip projects that help him alter plus-size shirts for himself and friends without making the process feel too precious. He and his boyfriend have a running joke about arguing over where to put throw pillows, though Yiming is serious about making their apartment feel cozy with strong contrast and warm lighting. On weekends he tests salsa roja de árbol and pico de gallo recipes, then logs the results in a tiny notebook originally meant for rating hotel lobby carpets.

basic_profile.name: Aram Uhm

occupation.title: Commercial property leasing coordinator for mixed-use developments

basic_profile.biography: Aram spends his weekdays touring retail vacancies, juggling tenant calls, and getting distracted by construction crews when a bulldozer is working near one of his properties. After work, he unwinds with his boyfriend by watching boxing previews, Camaro build videos, and the occasional road-rage compilation while promising himself he will finally organize the stack of leasing folders on his kitchen table. His faith is a steady part of his routine, especially gospel playlists and short devotionals about renewal, though he can spiral into late-night worries about privacy settings, headlines, and End Times videos. Surprisingly, he keeps a small balcony pond with rescued feeder goldfish and writes their names on tiny waterproof labels.

basic_profile.name: Paolo Nishida

occupation.title: State legislative policy analyst specializing in transportation safety and rural infrastructure

basic_profile.biography: Paolo spends his weekdays drafting blunt, meticulously sourced memos on road funding, vehicle regulation, and rural economic development for a statehouse committee. After work he decompresses with deadlifts, UFC highlights, and videos of Chihuahuas doing ridiculous tricks, though he insists he is “not a cute-dog-content guy.” On weekends he is usually pricing used trucks, tinkering with an LS-swap project, fishing from a kayak, or arguing that gasoline performance cars still have more soul than EVs. He keeps a small drawer of custom stationery and writes unusually formal love notes to his girlfriend, a habit he picked up from his grandfather rather than from social media.

basic_profile.name: Hikari Usami

occupation.title: Quality Systems Engineer at an electric vehicle battery components manufacturer

basic_profile.biography: Hikari spends her workdays tightening audit trails, tracing defects, and quietly improving processes on a factory floor where she prefers clear checklists to small talk. After work, she decompresses with Lakers highlights, UFC clips, WNBA posts about Angel Reese, and goofy couple-comedy videos she sends to her sister with a single laughing emoji. A surprising point of pride is that she collects vintage motel keychains and displays them in a perfectly labeled shadow box by her front door.

basic_profile.name: Damián Mireles

occupation.title: Airport community relations coordinator for a city aviation department

basic_profile.biography: Damián works for the city fielding neighborhood questions about airport expansion, noise maps, and public meetings, then goes home and watches landing videos like he didn’t just spend all day around aviation. He’s steady in his Christian faith, casually learning Amharic on his phone, and keeps a saved list of Addis Ababa brunch spots for a trip he keeps saying he’ll finally plan. His weekends are a mix of IMAX movie nights, track-and-field clips featuring Neeraj Chopra or Team USA, and half-finished DIY repairs like a bathroom caulking project he’s been “getting to” for weeks. He has a surprisingly serious collection of antique mechanical pencils, even though he mostly takes notes in a messy phone app.

basic_profile.name: Omari Okafor

occupation.title: Municipal legislative aide specializing in environmental resilience and public works policy

basic_profile.biography: Omari spends his workdays translating neighborhood complaints, tree-canopy maps, and council priorities into practical city ordinances. After hours, he is usually joking with other parents at his son's practice, checking PS5 system updates before a few rounds of Battlefield, or sending friends ridiculous dog videos. On weekends he likes short motorcycle rides, beginner guitar lessons, and the occasional deep-sea fishing clip rabbit hole. A detail people do not expect is that he keeps a neatly labeled collection of vintage city parking tokens in a cigar box on his desk.
